messages:
Olivia: Heads-up: ACME corp reported repeated 503s for their production app. They say it started when their flow triggered a toolcall on model 'redwood-3b-ctx32' with long function output. Stack trace in gateway shows upstream worker exited with code 139. CC @Tim @Raj
Tim: Thanks. Any trace IDs or example request?
Olivia: Trace id: 8f3a7c2c. Customer sent a reproducible curl. Pasting minimal payload below
Olivia: ```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk-...
{ "model":"redwood-3b-ctx32", "input":"<long conversation> + tool call", "max_tokens":1024 }
```
Maria: I'm seeing repeated `Segmentation fault (core dumped)` in the worker logs around that trace id. GPU memory climbs to 99% then OOM and process killed.
Raj: Likely KV prefetch / token cache blowup when toolcall returns large structured content. Which quant/profile are they on?
Olivia: They are on hosted default quant profile v2 (int8), no dedicated shard.
Leo: Got a snippet from the infra host dmesg: 
Leo: ```
[ 12345.678901] Out of memory: Killed process 9876 (infer-runner) total-vm:....
[ 12345.678910] gpu 0: GPU driver evicted process 9876 (CUDA OOM)
[ 12345.678920] infer-runner(9876) sigsegv at 0x7f...
```
Tim: Can we repro locally? Raj, can you try the customer's payload with a stress batcher to see if prefetch path reproduces?
Raj: Working on it. Running with the same model/quant locally. If it hits the same segfault, I'll attach gdb and collect a backtrace.
SRE-Bot: alert: worker-group hosted-3b-001 restarted (rolling) due to 5xx spike.
Olivia: Customer impact: ~6% of requests returned 503 in last 15m. They reported spike in retries and billing anomalies due to repeated attempts. Need an interim mitigation.
Tim: Immediate mitigations: 1) throttle requests from that API key, 2) route the key to fallback model redwood-3b-ctx16 (smaller ctx), 3) set `max_tokens` hard cap on gateway for that key. Can someone run a routing override?
Leo: I pushed a routing rule to route ACME key -> redwood-3b-ctx16. Also set a safety max_tokens=512. Monitor now.
Olivia: :thumbsup: Customer confirms drop in 503s after routing change. But we still need root cause and a fix.
Raj: Repro: ran their payload with long toolcall output + KV prefetch enabled. Hit segfault within ~8 iterations. Backtrace shows crash in attention kernel after prefetch growth. Saving core to /var/crash/core.
Raj: Backtrace excerpt:
Raj: ```
#0  0x7f... in nv_attention_kernel()
#1  0x7f... in kv_prefetch_step()
#2  0x55... in infer_step()
```
Maria: Noted. Looks like memory accounting underestimates when structured tool outputs expand token length. We may need conservative prefetch sizing or guardrails for function/tool outputs.
Tim: Create an incident ticket for follow-up: limit prefetch window by default and add telemetry to measure function output token expansion. Also schedule a canary release with prefetch disabled for this model.
Olivia: Filed INC-2026 with repro steps and included core dump link. Customer messaging: sent interim mitigation notes and ETA for follow-up.
Raj: Plan: 1) patch runtime to cap prefetch memory per-request 2) add fail-safe to fall back to CPU path instead of crashing 3) add detection to gateway to limit oversized toolcall outputs. I'll prototype branch today.
Maria: QA: add regression test that simulates toolcalls returning huge JSON arrays.
Olivia: Thanks team. Keeping customer updated. Will close this thread when patch deploys and ACME confirms stable. :eyes:
